description: Test and lint toolchain for ZeroBias modules and collector bots
author: team@zerobias.com
_comment_dependencies: dependencies: consumed ONLY as node_modules/.bin binaries, so npm may
peerDependencies: resolved by the consumer — imported by its source
via the gradle lint task's node_modules/... path), or loaded as ambient
types through tsconfig (@types/*). npm 7+ installs peers at the
consumer root, which is the only placement that guarantees resolution;
a plain dependency can nest and silently break these.
